title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct number of fissions per second is provided as 10^18.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of energy released per fission (200 MeV) is correctly identified and converted to joules.

title: Power Conversion
description: Important Criteria: The conversion of reactor power from MW to watts is accurately performed.

title: Division Setup
description: Important Criteria: The setup of the division N = Power / Energy per fission is correctly established.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units are consistently used throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the calculations are identified.
